claims.quote: polynucleotide kinase/phosphatase (PNKP) each act on a discrete set of modified strand-break termini.
Mutations in PNKP are considered to be responsible for Microcephaly with seizures (MCSZ) and Ataxia-ocular motor apraxia 4 (AOA4).
